configuration.ranking: descending rounded score; stable ascending entry ID for deterministic overlap
configuration.expected_overlap: sum(p_a * p_b) / k; independent uniform permutations of boundary ties
configuration.spearman: average ranks on all eligible candidates; constant ranks are undefined
configuration.case_selection: lowest mean expected overlap@10; ID tie-break; exclude previously represented sources
configuration.purpose: descriptive representation agreement; no labeled accuracy or historical coverage
